sections.title: About
sections.content:
I'm Jean Darry Paulette, a full-stack developer who turns ideas into clean, fast, and dependable web experiences. I care about craft, clarity, and building systems that scale without feeling heavy.

## What I focus on
- Product thinking that keeps the interface clear and intentional.
- TypeScript, React, and Next.js for stable, modern front-end work.
- Back-end foundations that are reliable, documented, and easy to maintain.
- Performance, accessibility, and design consistency from day one.

## How I work
- Align on goals, scope, and the real constraints.
- Build iteratively with checkpoints and demos.
- Deliver clean handoff material and transparent communication.

If you have a project in mind, I'd love to hear about it.
